tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark-first: graphite, almost black, with a faint blue bias; light is for print and the app's light theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed areas, POIS rows, inputs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The top layer: hover, selected, the panel bezel highlight.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and headings on every surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, spec labels (≥5.2:1 on surfaces).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and technical grids. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and card edges that must read (≥3:1 on bg in both themes).

tokens.name: titaani
tokens.usage: Metal highlight: knob, bezel edges, product chrome. Not for text on light.

tokens.name: merkkivalo
tokens.usage: THE ONLY COLOUR. PÄÄLLÄ / attention, the indicator light. As a fill, a glow and a dot; text on it uses #0a0c0e. Never body text on light.

tokens.name: merkkivalo-ink
tokens.usage: PÄÄLLÄ text and icons on surfaces (≥5:1).

tokens.name: merkkivalo-glow
tokens.usage: The soft halo around a lit indicator; PÄÄLLÄ row tint.

tokens.name: vaara
tokens.usage: Only real alarms (leak, connection lost). Never decoration.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one claim per surface: hero, poster headline, the video's end card.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Anturi kiinnittyy hanaan, jossa ei ole elektroniikkaa.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sensorit kiinnittyvät laitteisiin, jotka sinulla jo on.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Uppercase spec labels, callouts, section indexes. The deeptech voice.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live readings and timestamps; always tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inside sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Sections on desktop: generous darkness is part of the look.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, device rows; the sensor's corner at scale (12 mm on a 48 mm puck).

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Panels and product frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The knob, round buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-object
tokens.usage: Physical objects only: product frames, the panel mock, floating controls. Depth comes from light, never from flat card shadows.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: Around a lit indicator. One glowing thing per view.
